description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of difficulty levels within a dataset. The chart contains five slices, representing the categories “Medium,” “Hard,” “Easy,” “Very hard,” and “Very easy.” The “Medium” category is represented by a red slice and occupies approximately 51.8% of the chart; “Hard” is light blue and represents 25.7%; “Easy” is light green and accounts for roughly 11.2%; “Very hard” is a pale purple and comprises about 6.5%; and “Very easy” is gray and makes up the remaining portion. A legend is present, labeling each color with its corresponding difficulty level and associated count. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with “Medium” and progressing to “Very easy,” with a general trend of decreasing slice size.
